rule: Teaching dependencies: what a learner must already know for a sub-topic to make sense. build_registry.py writes them into prerequisite_ids on every objective of the dependent sub-topic. Authors of the dependent unit link to the prerequisite (cross_link block) and use its terms as the glossary settles them; they do not re-teach it. Topic 1 skills (graphs, units, variables, error) are prerequisites of every practical objective and are not listed one by one.
